title: Route C: Spectral Closure of the Zero-Density Law — Conditional on Two Analytic Gaps"
desc: We present a spectral approach to the Riemann Hypothesis via the normalized GCD operator Q_N, defined by Q_N[i,j] = 1/(gcd(i,j)√ij). The core result is the asymptotic limit λ_min(Q_N)/log N → −1/(2π), established as an original result for this normalized operator.
